questions.question: Confirm no amendments since the archived compilation alter 2-1601.J, 2-1602.G/H or 3-803.A.

Confirm IENCOD rear building setback line and seawall applicability; identify exceptions requiring documented City decisions.
Identify controlling neighborhood plans and current plats/declarations/private restrictions; GIS does not establish them.
Confirm residential/condominium uses and which shared-land projects need association/management permissions.
